== Published English Original Virtual Set 8 wording ==
The 2005 publication changes deploy and forfeit to 3 and 4, qualifies the weapon penalty and card exchange on another Tusken, and specifies other Tuskens in a separate forfeit sentence. The remaster prints all three functions under its opening Tusken Raider qualifier.
